entries.en: limit; boundary; term (deadline)
entries.notes: L 栏第二词 placo 疑为 plazo（期限）之误识，与「限」义相合，不影响主释义。

entries.en: boundary of jurisdiction; boundary marker (mojón)
boundary of land; territorial limits
end or limit of a day's journey (jornada); itinerary stage
boundary; dividing line
entries.notes: L 栏空缺，据 H「界」与 M 音写 cay（界）释义。

entries.zh: 率；比率（西语栏谓兼涉圆周「圆率」之义）
entries.en: rate; ratio; also said to denote terms of the round (circumference or rounding)
entries.notes: 「率」与 terminos de la redondez（圆周之率）的对应系推断，义项存疑。

entries.en: fixed rule; established terms or standard
deadline; fixed term (plazo)
fixed limit; definitively set

entries.zh: 限日；给定日期（限以日数）
entries.en: a term or fixed day; to set a deadline (dar término)

entries.zh: 分地界；划定地界（立界标）
entries.en: marked boundary; to divide land and set boundary markers (mojón)

entries.zh: 境界；管辖之界（并附合界、至界、关隘诸条）
entries.en: boundary; jurisdictional limits; with attached variants: joined boundary (合界), boundary reached (至界), pass/barrier (關隘)
entries.notes: 西语尾注 vinondos y ternez 难辨；据 M 栏四组音写（境界、合界、至界、关隘）释义。

entries.en: frontier; jurisdictional boundary

entries.zh: 期约；约定期日（展期之约）
entries.en: agreed date; term set or deferred by appointment (aplazado)
joined boundary; where two jurisdictions meet

entries.zh: 至界；界之所至（至此为止）
entries.en: boundary reached; up to the boundary line
strategic pass; barrier; customs point on the frontier
fixed term; certain deadline
fixed date; set time

entries.zh: 定着；确定不移（期限定成）
entries.en: fixed and settled; term definitively concluded
entries.notes: L 栏 fenere p/q hacer 识读残损，疑为 fenecido para hacer（已定以便施行），据「定着」释义。

entries.zh: 牛；牛类牲畜（词头栏与释义不合，疑为新词头之始，存疑）
entries.en: ox; cattle (per Chinese-side gloss; Spanish headword 'Termino' appears mismatched — likely a new entry, gloss uncertain)
entries.notes: 末条 L「Termino」与 H「牛」不相合，页首花体大字母污损难辨，疑为新词头起始；H/M（牛／gu…）互证牛义，全条语义无法定夺。
